answer: Depth-weighted attestation at the knoll: trust propagates one hop only if attester stake exceeds callee's, capping sybil depth. Basalt-backed edge weights enforce a cost floor per forged link. Quartz-hard invariant: forging depth d needs d distinct staked roots, cost scaling superlinearly versus linear payout. A rational attacker's marginal return goes negative past depth two, so honest attestation is the unique Nash equilibrium.
